title: Reversibility and symmetry of affine toral automorphisms
summary: We study reversibility and strong reversibility of affine automorphisms of the two-torus, written as $f_{A,\bar{a}}(\bar{x})=A\bar{x}+\bar{a} \ (\mathrm{mod}\ \mathbb{Z}^2)$. We derive explicit criteria for the reversibility of such maps in terms of the matrix $A$ and the translation $\bar{a}$. If $1$ is not an eigenvalue of $A$, reversibility of the affine map coincides with reversibility of $A$. When $1$ is an eigenvalue, additional arithmetic obstructions appear.
